steps.name: Web design in Settings
steps.goal: Tap Light once to switch the appearance to light. Do not tap Reset plans. Inspect the Settings plan screen without buying.
steps.done: The web heading and Starter purchase button are visible, with Appearance: light in the fixture header.
expect: Turn your ideas into a business.

steps.name: Select without buying
steps.goal: Tap the Personal plan radio card, not Continue with Personal.
steps.done: Personal is selected and its purchase button reads Continue with Personal. No purchase has started.

steps.name: Dark appearance
steps.goal: Tap Dark. Inspect the selected Personal card and button.
steps.done: The feature table, plan artwork, selection ring and purchase button are readable in dark appearance.

steps.name: Mock purchase through the real hook
steps.goal: Tap Continue with Personal once. This is mock StoreKit and cannot charge money.
steps.done: The existing purchase hook reaches its success screen.

steps.name: Empty storefront
steps.done: No plans are offered and restore remains available. There is no purchase button.
expect: No plans available on this device right now.

steps.name: Web subscriber cannot buy twice
steps.done: The existing web billing notice is visible and buying is disabled.
expect: You're subscribed through omg.dev on the web

steps.name: Store failure is recoverable
steps.done: The failed load shows an error and a retry button.
expect: The App Store didn't respond. Try again.

steps.name: Shared onboarding display
steps.goal: Tap Onboarding plan once. Do not change appearance in this step. Inspect the shared plan display.
steps.done: The onboarding plan step uses the same web heading and plan cards. Its skip action remains available.

steps.name: Onboarding in light appearance
steps.goal: Tap Light once. Do not tap Onboarding plan again.
steps.done: The onboarding plan display is in light appearance and retains the skip action.

steps.name: Onboarding in dark appearance
steps.goal: Tap Dark. Inspect the plan cards.
steps.done: The same plan step is readable in dark appearance and retains the skip and close actions.

steps.name: Skip retains the onboarding exit
steps.done: The existing skip callback fires without any purchase.
